video_title: Jaden McDaniels Postgame Interview After Win Against Memphis Grizzlies | 11.21.26

quotes.speaker: Jaden McDaniels
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaden McDaniels on his aggressive offensive approach against Memphis
quotes.excerpt: just staying aggressive whenever I get the ball, punching gaps and then just trusting my game

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: Jaden, it's a season high for you. You made a concerted effort not just to settle for the outside shot, to really get downhill. What were you able to do to get your way into their defense?

text_blocks.speaker: Jaden McDaniels
text_blocks.text: Just staying aggressive whenever I get the ball, punching gaps and then just trusting my game, trusting my work.

quotes.social_post: Jaden McDaniels on his season high performance against Memphis: Staying aggressive whenever I get the ball, punching gaps and then just trusting my game, trusting my work.

structured.context: Jaden McDaniels explains his offensive approach and decision to drive to the basket during the postgame interview.

quotes.speaker: Jaden McDaniels
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaden McDaniels on guarding Ty Jerome and maintaining defensive intensity
quotes.excerpt: defensively just being physical, picking up full court, disrupting them. I mean, he a good player

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: This morning when I asked you just about the mentality of playing both ends of the floor and not showing the tiredness, you said, 'It's something that I just have to fight through.' You guarded one of their better offensive players in Ty Jerome, especially with the way he's been shooting as of late. What was the mentality? How were you able to get it done on both ends of the floor tonight?

text_blocks.speaker: Jaden McDaniels
text_blocks.text: Defensively just being physical, picking up full court, disrupting them. I mean, he a good player and then offensively just staying confident when I get the ball and just staying in attack mode.

quotes.social_post: Jaden McDaniels on his defensive assignment against Ty Jerome: Defensively just being physical, picking up full court, disrupting them.

structured.context: Jaden McDaniels discusses his defensive strategy against Ty Jerome and maintaining his offensive intensity throughout the game.

quotes.speaker: Jaden McDaniels
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaden McDaniels on the Timberwolves' second-quarter defensive turnaround
quotes.excerpt: it started with defense. We were getting stops, making the miss and just getting out in transition

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: The team's mentality to make that fight in the second quarter to get the lead at halftime was what?

text_blocks.speaker: Jaden McDaniels
text_blocks.text: It started with defense. We were getting stops, making the miss and just getting out in transition, getting easy buckets and that's what flipped the game for us.

quotes.social_post: Jaden McDaniels on the Timberwolves second quarter turnaround: It started with defense. We were getting stops, making the miss and just getting out in transition, getting easy buckets and that is what flipped the game for us.

structured.context: Jaden McDaniels describes the Timberwolves defensive effort in the second quarter that allowed the team to take the lead.
